# Create PR from graph/<run-id>: Merge into, access check, Retry (KAN-103, GitHub push bug)

## What to build

Rewrite the workspace Create PR flow in `apps/graph-manager/src/server/pr.ts` so it pushes the run's `graph/<run-id>` branch and opens a PR into the **Merge into** branch, never touching the checkout. Steps `access` → `commit` → `push` → `create`. A failure shows a clear message and **Retry**, which resumes at the first unfinished step. This fixes the bug where a 403 on push left the run stuck with "no changes to open a PR". The spec is `docs/prd/done/isolated-workspaces.md`; read its Decisions and Requirements sections for this slice.

## Context: files to read before implementing

- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/pr.ts` (whole file, 338 lines) — today: `prStatus` requires uncommitted changes (line 165), `runPrJob` does checkout -b, add, commit, push, checkout back, create.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/routes/pr.ts` — GET/POST routes; `createBody`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/forges.ts` (lines 26–60, 150–200) — `ForgeClient`, `gitAuthArgs`, GitHub/GitLab `createPullRequest`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/specdone.ts` — `moveSpecToDone(root, specPath)`.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/server/worktrees.ts` (task 5) — `tempWorktree(wsPath, ref, name)`.
- `ctx.store.get().runBases` (task 7) — the run's start branch.
- `apps/graph-manager/src/web/pages/PrPanel.tsx` (lines 40–60 step names, ~217 failed job), `pages/Runs.tsx` (lines 25–30 `hasChanges`/`isReady`, 147 "no changes to open a PR").
- Tests: `server/routes/pr.test.ts` (a bare repo as `origin`), `web/pages/PrPanel.test.tsx`, `web/pages/Runs.test.tsx`, `web/pages/RunDetail.test.tsx` (line ~323).

## Step-by-step tasks

- **UPDATE** `pr.ts` `prStatus`: eligible when no stored PR, status `done` or `applied`, `graph/<run-id>` exists with `git rev-list --count <base>..graph/<run-id>` > 0 (base resolved locally or as `origin/<base>`); else `the run made no changes`. Remove the uncommitted-changes check. `suggested.branch = graph/<run-id>`; base default: `runBases` → `state.targetBranch` → current branch → forge default.
- **UPDATE** `PrStep = "access" | "commit" | "push" | "create"`. `access`: `git push --dry-run --porcelain origin graph/<id>:refs/heads/graph/<id>` with `gitAuthArgs`; output matching `/403|401|permission|denied/i` → `the <GitHub|GitLab> token can't push to <fullPath>: give it write access to the repository's contents (GitHub: "Contents: Read and write"), then Retry`. `commit`: only if the spec is under `docs/prd/` (not `done/`) at `graph/<id>`: `tempWorktree` on `graph/<id>`... note a temp worktree can't check out a branch already checked out elsewhere, so use `git worktree add <path> graph/<id>` only after confirming no other worktree has it, else `--detach` and `git update-ref refs/heads/graph/<id> HEAD <old>` after committing; always dispose. `push`: `git push --progress -u origin graph/<id>`. `create`: as today; on "already exists", look the PR up (add `findPullRequest(fullPath, head)` to both forge clients) and treat as success. Never run `git checkout` in the workspace.
- **ADD** retry: POST body `{ retry: true }` (other fields optional) → 409 `no failed Create PR to retry` unless the current job failed; the new job copies title/body/base and marks earlier `done` steps done.
- **UPDATE** web: PrPanel shows branch read-only, **Merge into** picker, the four steps, the error and `data-testid="pr-retry"`. Runs list: `ready for PR` / `PR failed: retry` / `the run made no changes`.
- **UPDATE tests** that expected `no uncommitted changes in the workspace` / `no changes to open a PR`. Add: 403 at access (simulate with an `origin` URL to a forge stub or a pre-receive hook that rejects) leaves HEAD/branch/status unchanged; retry after fixing completes; retry makes at most one spec-move commit; PR base differs from start branch.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No code path in pr.ts checks out a branch in the workspace.
- [ ] A rejected push fails at `access` with "token can't push"; Retry completes later.
- [ ] Retry never creates a second spec-move commit.
- [ ] `npm test -w graph-manager` passes.

## Validation commands

```bash
npm run typecheck && npm run lint
npm test -w graph-manager -- pr PrPanel Runs RunDetail
```
